tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Terudo developer documentation (Elements, partner API, webhooks, testing, AI tools, CLI). Returns the best sections with their URL and an excerpt; read a whole page with read_doc.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: The full Markdown of one documentation page, or one section with #anchor. Pages: index, quickstart, elements, integrate-in-your-flow, api, api-reference, webhooks, testing, ai-tools, cli. A URL from search_docs works too.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Every page of the Terudo developer documentation with its description and URL, and the agent skills.

tools.name: api_reference
tools.description: Exact partner API routes with key kind, parameters and examples. Query by route ("POST /orders", "/esims/{id}/topups") or words ("webhook", "element session"). Empty: the whole reference.

tools.name: elements_snippet
tools.description: Ready-to-paste code that mounts one Terudo Element in a page, for HTML, React, Next.js or Vue, with the trip data given. Optionally the server code for an element session (client discount, trusted email, reference, return URL).

tools.name: webhook_verifier
tools.description: Code verifying the Terudo-Signature header of a Terudo webhook, on the raw body, in Node.js (Express), Python (Flask), PHP or Ruby (Rails).

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: The full playbook (SKILL.md and its reference files) for integrating Terudo: terudo-elements (eSIM offer in web pages) or terudo-api (server-side API and webhooks). Follow its rules and checklist. Install it in a project with: npx -y @terudo/cli skills add

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, read_doc, list_docs, get_skill · Private data: get_skill · Public sink: api_reference, elements_snippet, webhook_verifier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, read_doc, list_docs, get_skill · Private data: get_skill · Public sink: api_reference, elements_snippet, webhook_verifier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
